town-entrance.title: Town Entrance - Demo
town-entrance.text: You stand at the entrance to a demonstration town showcasing the new conditional systems.

randomEncounters.title: Helpful Villager
randomEncounters.text: A friendly villager approaches and gives you some useful advice and a small gift!

randomEncounters.title: Lost Scholar
randomEncounters.text: A scholar studying magic seeks someone knowledgeable to discuss theories.

smart-path.title: Clever Observation
smart-path.text: Your keen intellect allows you to notice details others miss. You find a valuable item hidden nearby!

secret-passage.title: Hidden Passage
secret-passage.text: You discovered a secret passage that leads to a small chamber with ancient writings.

ancient-chamber.title: Ancient Chamber
ancient-chamber.text: The writings speak of a lost artifact. This could be the beginning of an important quest!

town-center.title: Town Center
town-center.text: The heart of the demonstration town. Various paths are available depending on your character.

choices.text: Use fire magic on brambles (Fire ability required)
Test Mount System Battle (Sky Crusher + Iron Beast)
Test Survival Battle (Survive 5 turns vs Iron Beast)
choices.survivalObjective: Survive the massive Iron Beast's assault for 5 turns while the town evacuates!

choices.text: Ultimate Challenge: 2v1 Battle (Sky Crusher + Iron Beast)
Test Crush Mechanics (Tiny Goblin + Massive Ogre + Iron Beast)

library-access.title: Grand Library
library-access.text: The librarian recognizes your intelligence and grants you access to rare books!

magic-study.title: Magical Research
magic-study.text: Your studies reveal powerful magical techniques!

history-study.title: Historical Discovery
history-study.text: You uncover important historical information that could prove valuable!

noble-conversation.title: Noble's Welcome
noble-conversation.text: The noble greets you warmly, appreciating your civilized appearance and manner.

political-discussion.title: Political Intrigue
political-discussion.text: The noble shares valuable political information and offers to introduce you to influential people.

noble-opportunities.title: Lucrative Opportunities
noble-opportunities.text: The noble offers you a well-paying job opportunity!

back-alley.title: Back Alley
back-alley.text: You find yourself in the shadows where outcasts and rogues gather. They eye you with cautious respect.

outcomes.text: They accept you as one of their own!

alley-acceptance.title: Accepted by Outcasts
alley-acceptance.text: The rogues welcome you into their circle and share some valuable black market information.

alley-rejection.title: Not Impressed
alley-rejection.text: The outcasts dismiss you as weak. You'll need to prove yourself elsewhere.

information-trade.title: Information Exchange
information-trade.text: You share what you know and learn some useful street knowledge in return.

quest-board.title: Town Quest Board
quest-board.text: A wooden board covered with various notices and requests for help from the townspeople.

cat-quest-start.title: Lost Cat Quest
cat-quest-start.text: Mrs. Henderson's cat Whiskers has gone missing. She last saw him near the old oak tree.

cat-quest-complete.title: Cat Found!
cat-quest-complete.text: Mrs. Henderson is overjoyed to have Whiskers back! She rewards you generously.

herb-quest-start.title: Herb Gathering Quest
herb-quest-start.text: The local healer needs rare herbs for medicine. She marks locations on your map.

cleared-path.title: Path Cleared by Fire
cleared-path.text: Your fire magic easily burns away the thorny brambles, revealing a hidden path with treasure!

fire-chamber.title: Chamber of Flames
fire-chamber.text: A chamber dedicated to fire magic. Ancient runes glow with warm light, and you feel your fire abilities strengthening.

quest-report.title: Quest Progress Report
quest-report.text: You report your findings about the ancient mystery to the town scholar. He's very interested in your discoveries!

quest-complete-celebration.title: Mystery Solved!
quest-complete-celebration.text: The town celebrates your contribution to solving the ancient mystery. Your reputation grows!

ranged-demonstration.title: Ranged Magic Display
ranged-demonstration.text: You demonstrate your ranged magical abilities, impressing the gathered crowd with your precision and power.

healing-demonstration.title: Healing Arts
healing-demonstration.text: You use your healing magic to help some injured townspeople. They're grateful for your assistance.

mount-test-victory.title: Mount System Test Complete!
mount-test-victory.text:
Congratulations! You have successfully defeated the Sky Crusher and Iron Beast duo. During the battle, you should have witnessed:

• Iron Beast attempting to mount or be mounted by Sky Crusher
• Devastating dogpile combos when one enemy pins you and the other follows up
• Combined weight damage calculations (400kg total)
• Aerial crush attacks if they formed a mount partnership

This demonstrates the advanced enemy AI coordination and mount formation systems!

battle-analysis.title: Advanced Combat Analysis
battle-analysis.text:
Reviewing the battle data reveals the sophisticated AI behaviors:

• Enemy coordination systems detected ally abilities
• Mount formation requirements calculated automatically
• Combo damage included combined creature weights
• Status effects properly managed mount partnerships

The combat system successfully demonstrated multi-enemy tactics, mount formations, and enhanced damage calculations!

survival-test-victory.title: Survival Test Complete!
survival-test-victory.text:
Excellent! You successfully survived 5 turns against the Iron Beast while the town evacuated. This demonstrates the survival battle system where victory comes from endurance rather than elimination.

Key features demonstrated:
• Turn counter showing survival progress
• Victory condition based on time rather than enemy defeat
• Tactical focus on defense and evasion
• Narrative context for survival objectives

evacuation-success.title: Heroes Welcome
evacuation-success.text: Thanks to your brave stand, all townspeople escaped safely! The mayor declares you a hero of the town and grants you special recognition.

ultimate-challenge-victory.title: ULTIMATE VICTORY!
ultimate-challenge-victory.text:
INCREDIBLE! You have defeated THREE enemies simultaneously! This epic 3v1 battle showcased the complete multi-enemy combat system:

🎯 FEATURES DEMONSTRATED:
• Multi-target selection UI
• Complex enemy coordination
• Multiple combo opportunities
• Strategic target prioritization
• Advanced AI behaviors
• Mount formations AND dogpile combos
• Sequential enemy turns with proper management

You are truly a master combatant! This represents the pinnacle of the enhanced combat system.

choices.text: Bask in the glory of victory!

crush-test-victory.title: CRUSH MECHANICS MASTERY!
crush-test-victory.text:
SPECTACULAR! You have defeated the Tiny Goblin, Massive Ogre, and Iron Beast trio! This battle perfectly demonstrated the advanced size-based crush mechanics:

🔥 CRUSH FEATURES DEMONSTRATED:
• Small character (Goblin size 1) mounting capabilities
• Large character (Ogre size 4) crush damage when sharing mounts
• Multi-rider weight stacking calculations
• Size-based vulnerability detection
• coordinated enemy AI with mount preferences
• Progressive crush damage scaling
• Mount partnership management under stress

Key mechanics observed:
• Goblin (40kg, size 1) can mount any target
• Ogre (350kg, size 4) crushes small riders when mounting same target
• Iron Beast (200kg, size 2) serves as stable mounting platform
• Weight ratios affect struggle mechanics and damage

The size-based crush system is working perfectly!

crush-analysis.title: Crush Mechanics Analysis
crush-analysis.text:
Detailed analysis of the crush mechanics battle reveals:

📊 SIZE INTERACTIONS:
• Tiny Goblin (size 1): Can mount any creature, vulnerable to crushing
• Iron Beast (size 2): Medium mount platform, stable for multiple riders
• Massive Ogre (size 4): Large crusher, can pin down small creatures

⚖️ WEIGHT CALCULATIONS:
• Single rider scenarios: Normal weight-based struggle mechanics
• Multi-rider scenarios: Combined weight affects mount stability
• Crush scenarios: Size difference determines crush damage multiplier

🤖 AI COORDINATION:
• preferredTarget settings guide mount selection
• Size awareness prevents impossible mount attempts
• Tactical crush positioning for maximum damage

The multi-rider crush system demonstrates sophisticated combat depth!

legendary-recognition.title: Legend Status Achieved
legendary-recognition.text: Word of your incredible 3v1 victory spreads throughout the land! Bards sing songs of your tactical prowess and combat mastery. You have become a living legend!
